sentences.en: He was accused of corrupting morals and spreading dangerous ideas.
sentences.zh: 他被指控败坏道德并传播危险的思想。

sentences.en: My father was religious and he was a very moral man.
sentences.zh: 我父亲很虔诚，他是个很有道德的人。

sentences.en: Moral and physical development are remarkable in the youth.
sentences.zh: 青少年在道德和身体上的发展都很显著。

senses.zh: 道德的，有关道德的；精神上的，心理上的
